source: Vatsal, 17 Sep 2026: the developers asked which inputs are mandatory and which are optional, that is, which ones stop the user from moving forward. One test decides it (an input is required only when the next screen cannot exist without it), every screen with an input gets a Moving forward block, and every captured field a tag: required, optional, default or system. The generated number and risk screens carry theirs from gen_spine.py.

card
Mandatory and optional inputs (17 Sep 2026)

Every screen with an input carries a Moving forward block in the spec panel: what the primary button needs, what is required, what is optional. Each captured field is tagged required (the button waits for it), optional (never blocks; skipped is not sure or empty, never zero), default (prefilled, counts as set, editable) or system (written by the app or a vendor, never typed).
The test: an input is required only when the next screen cannot exist without it: identity, consent, payment, the answer the next screen computes from, or the identity of an item being added.

Identity, consent and money are required: mobile and OTP; name, PAN, date of birth, email and the signed agreement; the payment method; bank account, FATCA and the nominee choice before the first order; the broker before a gateway order; the mandate type before a mandate.
The free reveal takes one tap per screen (R06, the feel of the journey, can be skipped); the eight risk questions take one answer each, no skip.

The data spine never blocks on a number: Continue is always enabled; a field is a value, explicit none or not sure; a gate field left not sure is asked again before the build (D10 lists it, D13 takes a range). The spine blocks in two places only: the risk questions and D10.

A list item saves with its identity alone (a member's relation, a loan's type, a policy's type, a goal's name); every amount on a detail screen is optional and becomes a Sharpen this link in the plan.

After the plan, nothing that helps us but not the user is required: call topics, cancel reasons, review confirmations and reminders are optional; a slot is required to book a call; at least one change is required to reopen the spine from Q06.
Admin: a record saves with its key (an ISIN, a publish reason); validation blocks publish, never typing.
